# Subway Seat for spotify_player

A full palette plus component styles: gold track titles, orange progress bar, avocado for what's playing, and a visualizer that climbs the 70s stripe.

[spotify_player](https://github.com/aome510/spotify-player) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/spotify-player/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, after adding the theme to the end of theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, after adding the theme to the end of theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, after adding the theme to the end of theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat-enamel"
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, after adding the theme to the end of theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "london-moquette"
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, after adding the theme to the end of theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "london-deep-level"
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, after adding the theme to the end of theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "london-portland"
```

**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, after adding the theme to the end of theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "paris-guimard"
```

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, after adding the theme to the end of theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "paris-catacombes"
```

**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, after adding the theme to the end of theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "paris-carrelage"
```

## Uninstall

- Delete the block between `# >>> subway-seat >>>` and `# <<< subway-seat <<<` in `~/.config/spotify-player/theme.toml`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
